reconstruction.scope: All 17 bodies, foundations/scaffolds/rubble, idle and attack in three directions for 11 rooftop Wizard families, four projectile tiers, all referenced particle artwork and seven sounds.
reconstruction.excludedCharacterActions: Walk, celebration and death metadata are retained but not imported as rooftop artwork. The die row names barbarian_death_1 with no SWF; no source is guessed.
reconstruction.preview: Original body/base plus direction-three idle Wizard at source origin; 360x380 at density two. This framing and rooftop placement are local and not verified native projection.
reconstruction.sourceBlends: Normal=0, screen=4 and additive=8 retained with isolated container composition and post-composition RGB transforms.
reconstruction.weapon: Tier one source speed is 500; tiers two through four are 900. All specify DontTrackTarget=TRUE, StartHeight=180 and StartOffset=70. Native timing and projectile height/offset semantics remain unverified.
